backend/main.mo: Motoko canister actor that stores contact form submissions in memory with timestamping and exposes methods to submit a new entry and retrieve all submissions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two WhatsApp CTA features, listing related frontend files, components, test requirements, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten high-level summaries of key frontend files, components, hooks, styles, and utilities used in the React application.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS setup defining design tokens, light/dark theme variables, and base styles for the application.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that sets up meta tags, page title, root div, and loads the React application bundle.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that applies theme handling and renders all main sections, the floating WhatsApp CTA, and the notification toaster.
frontend/src/components/About.tsx: About section component describing the company, goals, key features, and contact phone number using cards and iconography.
frontend/src/components/Contact.tsx: Contact section with company contact details and a form that submits data to the backend using a React Query mutation and shows toast feedback.
frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsApp: Fixed-position floating button that opens a WhatsApp chat to the business number using a centralized URL helper and safe-area-aware styling.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying company branding, quick navigation links with smooth scrolling, contact information, and attribution.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Implements a fixed responsive site header with logo and navigation that changes style on scroll, supports smooth scrolling to sections, and includes a toggleable mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Defines the hero landing section with background imagery, branding, AMC highlight, call-to-action buttons, smooth scrolling to sections, and WhatsApp contact integration.
frontend/src/components/Services.tsx: Renders a services section listing numerous electrical service offerings with icons, images, categories, and a helper to scroll to the contact section.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Provides a React Query hook that creates and caches a backend actor based on the current Internet Identity, recreating and invalidating dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an authentication context and provider for Dfinity Internet Identity, handling login, logout, identity persistence, and detailed login status state.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for submitting a contact form to the backend and fetching contact submissions using the authenticated actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind CSS base styles, theme variables (including industrial color schemes and dark mode), global utilities, smooth scrolling, and custom animations.
frontend/src/lib/whatsapp.ts: Centralizes WhatsApp business chat URL generation and defines a default booking inquiry message.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers and imports global styles.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration enabling class-based dark mode, scanning frontend source files, and extending the theme with container settings, extensive CSS-variable-driven color tokens, custom radii, shadows, animations, and UI keyframes. It also integrates official plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Machine-readable snapshot of the project describing a React + Tailwind single-page business website with theming, smooth navigation, and a contact form backed by an Internet Computer (Motoko) canister. It enumerates existing frontend features, integrations (Internet Identity, TanStack Query), and backend support modules with versioned metadata.
